responsibility: Declares the user-visible and internal target options for the RISC-V port. It defines `-m` switches, enums, masks, and target variables for ABI, ISA, tuning, code model, relaxation, save/restore, compressed-memory optimization, stack protector settings, and extension subfeature bitfields, providing the option-table metadata from which GCC generates command-line parsing and option state storage.
same_name_distinction: Within the `riscv` group, this `.opt` file is the option-description source for the port, declaring `-m` switches, enums, masks, and target variables such as ABI, code model, ISA spec, and extension flags. Unlike `riscv.cc` it contains no backend algorithms, unlike `riscv.h` it is not the main target configuration header, and unlike `riscv.md` it does not define instruction patterns.
